expo.name: Cue
expo.description: Live transcription and recall for conversations. Cue listens, keeps the thread, and tells you what was said and what you agreed to.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cue uses the microphone to transcribe the conversation you are in.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Cue turns what it hears into text so you can read and search the conversation afterwards.
